focusAreas.#Appraisal: A set of terms typically used in various appraisal forms, for example, agency forms and the GSE's Uniform Appraisal Dataset (UAD).
focusAreas.#ArtificialIntelligence: A set of terms approved by the MISMO Artificial Intelligence Community of Practice.
focusAreas.#ClosingDisclosure: A set of terms typically used in loan closing disclosures, for example, the Loan Estimate, Closing Disclosure, or datapoints from the GSE Uniform Closing Dataset (UCD).
focusAreas.#Commercial: A set of terms, processes or documents as it relates to the mortgage business where the loan is secured by non-residential income producing property.
focusAreas.#CreditReporting: A set of terms from the MISMO Reference Model, grouped by the Credit Reporting Community of Practice.
focusAreas.#DGMFitForPurpose: A set of terms grouped by the MISMO Data Governance & Management (DGM) Fit For Purpose Framework artifact.
focusAreas.#eMortgage: A set of terms that refer to electronically signed closing documents paired with an original digital promissory note.
focusAreas.#iLAD: A set of terms that comprise the Industry Loan Application Dataset (iLAD).
focusAreas.#LDD: A set of terms grouped by the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD) data points.
focusAreas.#LoanApplication: A set of terms that comprise the mapping of each Uniform Residential Loan Application (URLA) field to supporting MISMO v3.4 fields.
focusAreas.#LoanDelivery: A set of terms typically used in a Loan Delivery transaction, for example, datapoints from the GSE Uniform Loan Delivery Dataset (ULDD).
focusAreas.#MBAGlossary: A set of terms included in the Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA) Business Glossary.
focusAreas.#MISMOApprovedAcronym: A set of acronyms that have been approved for use within a MISMO data point name, definition or enumeration.
focusAreas.#MISMOLifeOfLoan: A set of terms grouped by the MISMO products and their relationship to “typical” processes within the mortgage lifecycle.
focusAreas.#Origination: A set of terms, processes or documents related to the completion of the residential or commercial mortgage application.
focusAreas.#Secondary: A set of terms, processes or documents related to developing mortgage products to originate, managing interest rate risk, setting pricing, and executing the sale, securitization, or retention of mortgage loans in a way that optimizes liquidity, profitability, and balance sheet efficiency.
focusAreas.#Servicing: A set of terms, processes or documents related to the following mortgage banking functions: receipts of payments, customer service, escrow administration, investor accounting, collections and foreclosures.

termTypes.Actor: Represents an individual, entity, or system, or a collection of individuals or entities, or systems. They are often associated with a particular role in the mortgage process.
termTypes.Data: Represents data points as documented in the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD). It also includes items from a third party source (e.g., amounts, dates, calculations, rates, and numbers).
termTypes.Document: Record(s) of information, typically in written or digital form, that provides evidence, details, or context about a particular topic, event, or transaction (e.g., Uniform Residential Loan Application).
termTypes.Event: Thing that happens, especially one that is of importance (e.g., an act of God; accident; accretion). It occurs at a particular date or time period.
termTypes.Other: A category for terms that do not fall into one of the other defined category types.
termTypes.Outcome: The result of a process whether intended or unintended.
termTypes.Process: Represents an action, or actions, to be taken (e.g., Take Loan Application; Underwrite Loan; Close Loan; Origination). A process tends to occur over time.
termTypes.Product: Represents the characteristics of a financial instrument secured by property.
termTypes.Regulation: A rule or set of rules that control or govern a system, process, or behavior.

sources.Artificial Intelligence Glossary: A set of terms originating from the Artificial Intelligence Community of Practice published AI Glossary.
sources.Data Governance & Management CoP (DGM): A set of terms grouped by the MISMO Data Governance & Management (DGM) Community of Practice.
sources.LDD Acronym: A set of terms sourced from the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD) Approved Acronym List.
sources.LDD Attribute: A set of terms sourced from the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD) Attribute list.
sources.LDD Document: A set of terms sourced from the MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD) Document Type Enumerations List.
sources.MBA Glossary: A set of terms included in the Mortgage Bankers Association (MBA) Business Glossary. Published on MISMO's site as “MBA Business Glossary”; the glossary data uses the shorter “MBA Glossary”.
sources.MISMO (Non-LDD): A set of terms originating from a MISMO source, including from other artifacts published by MISMO workgroups (e.g. white papers).
sources.MISMO eMortgage: A set of terms that refer to electronically signed closing documents paired with an original digital promissory note.
sources.MISMO Governing Documents: A set of terms derived from the MISMO Development Process Document (DPD), MISMO Policies and Procedures (P&P), or MISMO Intellectual Property Rights (IPR).
sources.MISMO Life of Loan: A set of terms grouped by the MISMO Life of Loan Business Process Model and Community of Practice.
sources.MISMO Logical Data Dictionary (LDD): A set of terms that comprise the MISMO model.

changeSet.Term: Ability To Repay Exemption Reason Type
changeSet.Definition: Specifies the reason that transaction is exempt from Regulation Z Ability-To-Repay requirements.
Specifies the method by which the creditor satisfied Regulation Z Ability-to-Repay requirements.
A unique value that represents a user defined version identifier.
The ActualSignatureType contains the actual type of the signature applied to the signature field.
Contains a description of the signature type when the value of Other is used for the ActualSignatureType attribute.
The address with the address number, pre-directional, street name, post-directional, address unit designators and address unit value.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the type of address.

A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies a further level of detail for a street address, for example, Suite or Unit. This list is based on the USPS Publication 28 on Postal Addressing Standards.
The identifier value associated with the Secondary Address Unit Designator. Example: 123, C, B1C, etc.
Specifies whether the occurrence of the adjustment is the first change or a subsequent change.
A classification or description of a loan or a group of loans generally based on the changeability of the rate or payment over time.

A unique identifier assigned by a party for all appraisal data delivered to the party for this loan. The party assigning the identifier can be provided using the IdentifierOwnerURI associated with a MISMO identifier.
The annual percentage rate for the loan based on the accepted industry standard defined by Regulation Z (Section 12 C.F.R. 1026.18(e)) used for Qualified Mortgages and general disclosure purposes.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies financial assets in a mortgage loan transaction. Assets may be either liquid or fixed and are associated with a corresponding asset amount.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected as the Asset Type.
Indicates whether the loan is assumable by another borrower.
The dollar amount of an existing loan assumed by the borrower.
A unique identifier assigned by the underwriting system to the underwriting case for a specific loan application.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the automated underwriting system used to evaluate a loan.

changeSet.Term: Automated Underwriting System Type Other Description
changeSet.Definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Automated Underwriting System Type.

An annual percentage rate that is derived from average interest rates, points, and other loan pricing terms currently offered to consumers by a representative sample of creditors for mortgage transactions that have low-risk pricing characteristics. The Federal Reserve Board publishes average prime offer rates for a broad range of types of transactions in a table updated at least weekly. This rate is used in determining Higher Priced Mortgage Loans (HPML).
When true, indicates that a final balloon payment is required to fully pay off the loan.
The dollar amount of the final, or lump sum, balloon payment.

The time interval in months between interest rate increases during the buydown period. For example if the interest rate increases annually during a two year buydown, the frequency of interest rate change is 12 months.
The total number of months during which any buydown is in effect. This represents the accumulation of all of the buydown periods.
The amount by which the interest rate can increase at each adjustment period within the buydown duration.

changeSet.Term: Buydown Initial Effective Interest Rate Percent
changeSet.Definition: The final bought down interest rate. The rate that the applicant will pay after the buydown is applied.
When true, indicates that the buydown rate is reflected in the note.
When true, indicates that there is buydown funding on this loan that reduces the interest rate and/or the payments for a specified period.

changeSet.Term: Cash From Borrower At Closing Amount
changeSet.Definition: The total dollar amount required from the borrower to consummate the closing of a real estate transaction.

changeSet.Term: Cash From Seller At Closing Amount
changeSet.Definition: The total dollar amount required from the seller to consummate the closing of a real estate transaction.

changeSet.Term: Cash To Borrower At Closing Amount
changeSet.Definition: The total dollar amount received by the borrower to consummate the closing of a real estate transaction.

changeSet.Term: Cash To Seller At Closing Amount
changeSet.Definition: The total dollar amount received by the seller to consummate the closing of a real estate transaction.
The stated maximum percentage to which the interest rate can increase over the life of the loan.

changeSet.Term: Ceiling Rate Percent Earliest Effective Months Count
changeSet.Definition: The minimum number of months at which the maximum interest rate could be reached.
The name of the city or Military APO FPO designation.
The dollar amount of the specified Closing Adjustment Item Type. A positive amount indicates a credit to the Buyer.

changeSet.Term: Closing Adjustment Item Paid Outside Of Closing Indicator
changeSet.Definition: When true, indicates payment of the closing adjustment item was paid outside of closing.
The type of adjustment made during the origination process.

changeSet.Term: Closing Adjustment Item Type Other Description
changeSet.Definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Closing Adjustment Item Type.
The identifying file number assigned to the transaction by the Closing Agent also known as a Settlement Agent.
The dollar amount of funds supplied by a specified source at closing.

The date the closing documents were fully executed and the borrower becomes contractually responsible for the debt. Depending on the location (wet-sign, dry-sign, table-funded and/or escrow state) of the loan closing, the Closing Date may be the same date as either the Document Preparation Date and/or the Execution Date and/or the Recorded Date.
When true, indicates that the loan is a construction loan.

changeSet.Term: Construction Loan Total Term Months Count
changeSet.Definition: The total term of a construction loan, including the construction phase plus the fully amortizing phase.
Specifies the specific type of construction loan.

changeSet.Term: Construction Period Number Of Months Count
changeSet.Definition: The length of the construction period expressed in number of months.
The email address for the contact.
The extension associated with the specified telephone number.
The telephone number for the contact.
The two-character representation of the country.
The date and time at which the message, deal or document was created.
Date on which the interest rate for the loan was set by the lender for the final time before closing.
Specifies the data file version.
When true, indicates that upon the foreclosure sale completion deficiency rights against the borrowers are preserved.
When true, indicates that the loan has a demand feature.
The date the loan funds are disbursed to the borrower or another party on the borrower's behalf.
The value of the fully indexed interest rate, expressed as a percent, which must be disclosed to the borrower for adjustable rate mortgages.

changeSet.Term: Document Form Issuing Entity Name Type
changeSet.Definition: Identifies the organization that defined the document form/template.

changeSet.Term: Document Form Issuing Entity Version Identifier
changeSet.Definition: The version identifier that the issuer assigned to the document form/template.
When true, indicates that a signatory must execute a signature on the document.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents either a category of document or a category and sublevel of a document combined into a single enumeration.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Document Type.

The XML compatible byte stream in the encoding of the EncodingType that when decoded is a resource of the MediaType using characters from the CharacterEncodingSetType. If a binary EncodingType is not used (e.g. "None" or "EscapedXML") then the CharacterEncodingSetType must be the same as that used for the XML instance document.
The date and time the action occurred. The time must always contain the proper time zone designator.
Specifies the reason the loan does not have an escrow account.
The amount of any adjustment made to the initial escrow account balance based on Regulation X requirements.

changeSet.Term: Escrow Collected Number Of Months Count
changeSet.Definition: The number of months escrow to be collected at closing for the escrow item.
Indicates whether or not escrows are associated with this loan.
The actual dollar amount paid by a specific party at a specified time for a specified escrow item.

changeSet.Term: Escrow Item Payment Paid By Type
changeSet.Definition: The role of the party making the escrow item payment.
Defines the point in time during the origination process when the escrow item payment was paid.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents an item that may be held and managed in an escrow account.
A free-form text field to collect additional information when Other is selected for Escrow Item Type.
The monthly payment amount for the escrow item.
For a step in a process, contains the type of action or state.
A free-form text field used to describe the type of action or state if Other is selected as the Event Type.
The date the signature was or will be affixed to the document.
The date and time the signature was affixed to the document.
The actual dollar amount paid by a specific party at a specified time for a specified fee or cost.
The actual total dollar amount paid for the fee by all parties.
Identifies the category or type of payee to which the fee or payment will be paid.

changeSet.Term: Fee Paid To Type Other Description
changeSet.Definition: A free-form text field to capture the description when Other is selected as Fee Paid To Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the role of the party paying a fee or cost.

changeSet.Term: Fee Payment Paid Outside Of Closing Indicator
changeSet.Definition: When true, indicates payment of fee was paid outside of closing.
Defines the amount upon which the Fee Total Percent is calculated.

changeSet.Term: Fee Summary Total Amount Financed Amount
changeSet.Definition: The amount of the Total Amount Financed as disclosed based on the accepted industry standard defined by Regulation Z.

changeSet.Term: Fee Summary Total Finance Charge Amount
changeSet.Definition: The amount of the Total Finance Charges as disclosed based on the accepted industry standard defined by Regulation Z.
The total amount of interest paid by the borrower over the term of the loan as a percentage of the loan amount.

changeSet.Term: Fee Summary Total Of All Payments Amount
changeSet.Definition: The amount of the Total of All Payments as disclosed based on the accepted industry standard defined by Regulation Z.

The total percent paid by all parties for the specified Fee or Specified HUD Line Number. This is used in conjunction with the Fee Percent Basis Type to determine a dollar amount of the fee. May be used in conjunction with Specified Fixed Amount to determine the dollar amount of the fee. To be used when the fee is defined by a percent.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a fee or cost associated with a real estate transaction or the ongoing servicing of a loan.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Fee Type.
The first name of the individual represented by the parent object.

changeSet.Term: First Principal And Interest Payment Change Months Count
changeSet.Definition: The number of months after origination in which the first payment adjustment occurs.
The number of months after origination in which the first interest rate adjustment occurs, if the interest rate on the subject loan can change.

changeSet.Term: First Year Total Escrow Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: Estimated total amount of one year of escrowed property costs.

changeSet.Term: First Year Total Escrow Payment Description
changeSet.Definition: A free-form text field used to describe the estimated total amount of one year of escrowed property costs.

changeSet.Term: First Year Total Non Escrow Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: Estimated total amount of one year of non-escrowed property costs.

changeSet.Term: First Year Total Non Escrow Payment Description
changeSet.Definition: A free form text field used to describe the estimated total amount of one year of escrowed property costs.
The stated minimum percentage the interest rate can decrease to over the life of the loan.
The unparsed name of either an individual or a legal entity.

changeSet.Term: Fully Indexed Initial Principal And Interest Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: The dollar amount of the principal and interest payment when calculated using the loan amount and fully-indexed interest rate (in place of Note Interest Rate) to arrive at full amortization during the loan term.
A value from a MISMO defined list that specifies a monetary source commonly used to pay obligations in a mortgage loan transaction.
Indicates whether hazard is paid by the borrower or the lender.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the general category of mortgage index to be used to determine the interest rate at each adjustment.
A free-form text field to collect additional information when Other is selected for Index Type.

changeSet.Term: Initial Principal And Interest Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: The dollar amount of the principal and interest payment as stated on the Note. The principal and interest payment is usually obtained using the loan amount and interest rate to arrive at full amortization during the loan term.

changeSet.Term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Amount Changed Indicator
changeSet.Definition: When true, indicates the estimated and final cash to close amounts for the specified Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type are unequal.

changeSet.Term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Change Description
changeSet.Definition: A statement providing information related to the difference between the estimated and final cash to close amounts for the specified Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type.

changeSet.Term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Estimated Amount
changeSet.Definition: The estimated cash to close amount for the specified integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type.

changeSet.Term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Final Amount
changeSet.Definition: The final cash to close amount for the specified Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type.

changeSet.Term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Payment Type
changeSet.Definition: Identifies whether the Cash To Close Item Amount is due to or from the borrower.

changeSet.Term: Integrated Disclosure Cash To Close Item Type
changeSet.Definition: Identifies the type of cash to close item as specified in the Calculating Cash to Close section of the integrated disclosure document.

changeSet.Term: Integrated Disclosure Home Equity Loan Indicator
changeSet.Definition: When true, indicates the loan is an extension of credit that does not involve the purchase of real property or the initial construction of a dwelling and will not be used to refinance an existing obligation.
The date the integrated disclosure was mailed or delivered to the consumer (borrower or seller) as reflected on a single instance of the integrated disclosure document. AKA "Date Issued".
A description of the loan product which includes, when applicable, certain loan features added to the loan product that may change the periodic loan payment.
The total amount of itemized charges and credits within a specified section of the integrated disclosure document.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the title or description of a primary section of an integrated disclosure document.

changeSet.Term: Integrated Disclosure Subsection Paid By Type
changeSet.Definition: The role of the party making the payment of the amount associated with the Integrated Disclosure Subsection Total Amount.
The dollar amount of the individual payment being made associated with the Integrated Disclosure Subsection Type.

changeSet.Term: Integrated Disclosure Subsection Payment Timing Type
changeSet.Definition: Defines the point in time during the origination process when the integrated disclosure subsection payment was paid.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the title or description of a subsection of an integrated disclosure document.
When true, indicates that the loan terms allow interest-only payments to be made for a specified time period.
Then number of months the loan remains interest only.
When true, indicates that the interest rate on the loan can increase after the closing.
The last name of the individual represented by the parent object.

The dollar amount that a borrower is required to pay for failure to make a regular installment within the period specified on the note. This is used when late charge is defined as a flat dollar amount.

changeSet.Term: Late Charge Grace Period Days Count
changeSet.Definition: The grace period in days for this loan before a late charge will be applied.

The percentage that a borrower is required to pay for failure to make a regular installment within the period specified on the note. This is the amount specified by the late charge code and is used when the late charge is not a flat dollar.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents the payment basis used in calculating the late charge amount.
The amount necessary to bring the final actual costs in line with the amount initially disclosed to the borrower.
A text description that further defines the Liability. This could be used to describe the job related expenses.

changeSet.Term: Liability Secured By Subject Property Indicator
changeSet.Definition: When true, indicates the specified liability is secured by the subject property.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that represents a financial obligation of an individual or entity. In a mortgage transaction, these are typically related to one or more borrowers.
Specifies the other liability type when Other is selected.
Level of authority of the license issuer.
The identifier of the license or certificate issued to the party. The attribute IdentifierOwnerURI identifies the issuer of the license or certificate.
The date on which the license was issued.
The name of the issuing authority through which the party obtained the license.
The two-character representation of the US state, US Territory, Canadian Province, Military APO FPO, or Territory in which the party is licensed or certified to operate.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the priority of the lien against the property.
When true, indicates that the loan amount can increase after closing.
The value of the identifier for the specified type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the type of loan identifier.
A free-form text field used to describe the Loan Identifier Type when Other is selected as the Loan Identifier Type.
Indicates that the loan was manually underwritten.
The scheduled number of periods (as defined by Loan Maturity Period Type) after which the loan will mature.
The unit of time used to define the period over which the loan matures. Used in conjunction with Loan Maturity Period Count.

changeSet.Term: Loan Price Quote Interest Rate Percent
changeSet.Definition: The mortgage loan interest rate for which the price quote is calculated.
Specifies the purpose for which the loan proceeds will be used.
The maximum possible number of months for the term to maturity, if the term to maturity is extendable.
The number of percentage points to be added to the index to arrive at the new interest rate.
The number assigned by the private mortgage insurance company to track a loan.
To convey the private MI company short/common name from whom the private mortgage insurance coverage was obtained.

changeSet.Term: MI Company Name Type Other Description
changeSet.Definition: A free-form text field used to describe the MI company name when Other is selected for the MI Company Name Type.
Indicates that Mortgage Insurance is or was required as a condition for originating the loan.

The projected mandatory date the mortgage insurance must be terminated when a set loan to value percent is reached as identified by HOEPA regulations. Also known as Mandatory MI Termination Date on PMI disclosure documents.
The middle name of the individual represented by the parent object.

Indicates the Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions type of the data in the resource. A registered list of these types is available at http://www.iana.org/assignments/media-types/ AND http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2045. In addition, there is a defined syntax for custom MIME types that should be followed when the type is not registered with IANA.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies the private or public sector entity under whose guidelines the mortgage is originated.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information or a description of the mortgage type when Other is selected.
When true, indicates that the loan terms allow unpaid interest to be added to the principal of the loan that can or will result in negative amortization.
The limit (in months) during which negative amortization is allowed and after which the loan is re-amortized.

changeSet.Term: Negative Amortization Maximum Loan Balance Amount
changeSet.Definition: Then maximum loan balance with accrued increase from negative amortization. (The initial loan amount plus any balance increase that may accrue from the negative amortization provision).

Specifies whether negative amortization is scheduled or potential on the loan. Negative amortization is unpaid interest added to the mortgage principal. This applies to loans where the principal balance increases because the payments do not cover the interest.
The amount to be repaid as disclosed on the note.
The actual interest rate as disclosed on the note.
Specifies the type of encoding used by the resource.
Identifies the resource name (e.g. CreditReport0001.pdf).
When true, indicates that the service and associated cost are not required by the creditor. This includes premiums paid for separate insurance, warranty, guarantee or event-coverage products.
When true, indicates that the terms of the loan allow principal and interest payments that are less than the amount due.
The method used for applying a partial payment to the loan.

changeSet.Term: Partial Payment Application Method Type Other Description
changeSet.Definition: A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Partial Payment Application Method Type.
The unique identifier assigned to the party role.
A value from a MISMO defined list that identifies the role that the party plays in the transaction. Parties may be either a person or legal entity. A party may play multiple roles in a transaction.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Party Role Type.
A value from a MISMO prescribed list that specifies how often the obligor must make the financing payments.
When true, indicates that the payments on the loan can increase after the closing.
Specifies that the loan instrument allows the borrower(s) to determine and change on a month-to-month basis the amount of any payment to be paid on the loan for a specified period of time.
The dollar amount for the debt that is being paid off as part of the closing transaction.
The dollar amount of the Prepayment Penalty charged on the account being paid in full.

changeSet.Term: Per Change Maximum Increase Rate Percent
changeSet.Definition: The maximum number of percentage points by which the rate can increase from the previous interest rate.

changeSet.Term: Per Change Maximum Principal And Interest Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: The maximum dollar amount of the principal and interest payment possible for the specified payment change.

changeSet.Term: Per Change Minimum Principal And Interest Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: The minimum dollar amount of the principal and interest payment possible for the specified payment change.

changeSet.Term: Per Change Principal And Interest Payment Adjustment Frequency Months Count
changeSet.Definition: The number of months between payment adjustments, if the payment on the subject loan can change.

changeSet.Term: Per Change Rate Adjustment Frequency Months Count
changeSet.Definition: The number of months between rate adjustments, if the interest rate on the subject loan can change.
The dollar amount of personal property included in the Sales Contract Amount.
Indicates if there is personal property included in the contract for sale.
The postal code (ZIP Code in the US) for the address. ZIP Code may be either 5 or 9 digits.
The actual dollar amount paid by a specific party at a specified time for a specified Prepaid Item Type.
The number of months covered by the Prepaid Item Type.
The start date for calculating the total number of days covered by the prepaid item.
The end date for calculating the total number of days covered by the prepaid item, inclusive of this date.

changeSet.Term: Prepaid Item Payment Paid By Type
changeSet.Definition: The role of the party making the breakout payment.
Defines the point in time during the origination process when the prepaid item payment was paid.
The dollar amount charged per day for the prepaid item.

changeSet.Term: Prepaid Item Per Diem Calculation Method Type
changeSet.Definition: The number of days in the year used in calculating the dollar amount charged per day for the prepaid item per diem amount.
Identification of a monthly housing expense component that must be paid in advance.
A free-form text field used to collect additional information when Other is selected for Prepaid Item Type.
The number of months from the loan closing that a prepayment penalty may be imposed.
Indicates whether the loan includes a penalty charged to the borrower in the event of prepayment.

changeSet.Term: Prepayment Penalty Maximum Life Of Loan Amount
changeSet.Definition: Maximum dollar amount that can be charged as a prepayment penalty over the life of the loan.

changeSet.Term: Principal And Interest Payment Maximum Amount
changeSet.Definition: The stated maximum principal and interest payment amount allowed over the life of the loan.

changeSet.Term: Principal And Interest Payment Maximum Amount Earliest Effective Months Count
changeSet.Definition: The minimum number of months before the maximum payment amount to which the principal and interest payment can increase over the life of the loan could be reached.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Calculation Period End Number
changeSet.Definition: The end number of the projected payment period. Used in conjunction with Projected Payment Calculation Period Term Type.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Calculation Period Start Number
changeSet.Definition: The start number of the projected payment period. Used in conjunction with Projected Payment Calculation Period Term Type.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Calculation Period Term Type
changeSet.Definition: The duration of time used to define the projected payment period.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Calculation Period Term Type Other Description
changeSet.Definition: A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Projected Payment Calculation Period Term Type.
Specifies if the projected payment item is to be paid from an escrow account.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Estimated Escrow Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: The estimated amount of the payment that is applied toward escrows during the projected payment period.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Estimated Taxes Insurance Assessment Component Type
changeSet.Definition: Specifies the type of payment component included in the calculation of the Projected Payment Estimated Taxes Insurance And Assessment Total Amount.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Estimated Taxes Insurance Assessment Component Type Other Description
changeSet.Definition: A free-form text field used to capture additional information when Other is selected for Projected Payment Estimated Taxes Insurance Assessment Component Type.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Estimated Taxes Insurance Assessment Total Amount
changeSet.Definition: The estimated total of property tax, property insurance, and property assessment payment amounts during the projected payment period.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Estimated Total Maximum Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: The estimated maximum amount of the total payment during the projected payment period.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Estimated Total Minimum Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: The estimated minimum amount of the total payment during the projected payment period.
The amount of the payment that is applied toward mortgage insurance during the projected payment period.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Principal And Interest Maximum Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: The maximum amount of the principal and interest payment during the projected payment period.

changeSet.Term: Projected Payment Principal And Interest Minimum Payment Amount
changeSet.Definition: The minimum amount of the principal and interest payment during the projected payment period.
A statement of the estimated present market value of the property that is from the borrower or loan originator.
Statement of value of the property from a valid property valuation source.
